system.notes:
A mini-grenade for a grenade launcher (SR3 p.283): the Offensive HE Grenade's effects, fired rather than thrown. It does not arm until it has travelled about five metres (SR3 p.118).

SR3 p.283, the Mini-grenade row applied to the Offensive HE Grenade row: Conceal 8, Weight .1, Availability 4/4 days +2, Cost 30¥ ×2, Street Index 2 +1. Legality 3-J. Blast –1/m.
